title: AI Runtime Exposure Hardening

operatorSteps.title: Review AI runtime assessment
operatorSteps.instruction: Review endpoint exposure, authentication, tool binding, memory, prompt-boundary, logging, rate-limit, and tenant-isolation findings.

operatorSteps.title: Plan runtime boundary controls
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing plan for auth, token scoping, memory isolation, prompt/tool boundary enforcement, logging redaction, and rate limits.

operatorSteps.title: Record reassessment command
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the command to rerun after approved controls are applied.

recommendedControls: Scope runtime tokens by tenant, tool, and environment.
Isolate memory stores by tenant and sensitivity.
Pin system prompts and isolate tool instructions.
Enable output schema enforcement and logging redaction.
Enable rate limits and abuse thresholds.
nonClaims: This playbook does not call model endpoints.
This playbook does not execute prompts.
This playbook does not modify runtime configuration.
This playbook does not authorize live remediation.
